_Description: Column description of the ADNI4 phenotype table (sidecar of phenotype.csv, see studies/template/phenotype.json). The first row gives the study defaults of all sessions, add one row per participant or session below (e.g. of the IDA search table of the images).

participantID.Description: ADNI subject ID as stored in the DICOM PatientID, e.g. 123_S_4567 (key column, not exported).

scandate.Description: Date of the scan session (key column, not exported), e.g. the acquisition date of the IDA search table. Empty: all sessions of the participant.

studyName.Description: ADNI phase of the session, e.g. ADNI3 or ADNI4.

participantGroup.Description: Research group of the enrollment, i.e. CN, SMC, EMCI, MCI, LMCI, or AD (CN is coded as NC by the phenotype dictionary).

sex.Description: Sex of the participant (M or F).
